The workbook itself, or a readable export of the relevant worksheet/cells, is required. I located the budget-review file, but I’m unable to read the worksheet contents needed to verify the travel allocations and the highlighted discrepancies. Could you resend the workbook or paste/export the relevant travel-allocation section?

Best,
Alice
